user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends and we need to find some interesting landmarks and attractions along the way. Can you suggest some must-visit places between New York City and Los Angeles? It would be great if you could also provide information about nearby hotels and restaurants.

TaskList.description: Identify major landmarks and attractions between New York City and Los Angeles.
Gather details about nearby hotels for each landmark identified in step 1.
Collect information about restaurants near each landmark.
